title: Integral-to-finite coefficient tensor and direct-image mates in a two-term perfect model
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $O=\mathcal O_E$ with its valuation topology [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a continuous unital map $a:O\to A$ to a finite commutative discrete ring killed by a power of $\ell$. Use the condensed rings $\underline O,\underline A$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every scheme $Z$, put $O_Z=p_Z^*\underline O$, $A_Z=p_Z^*\underline A$ [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point], and use ordinary uncompleted module derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. There exist $r\ge0$ and an $O$-linear matrix $\phi:O^r\to O^r$ with a surjection $q:O^r\to A$ such that, for all $Z$, the augmented two-term complex
$$P_Z=[O_Z^{\oplus r}\xrightarrow{\phi_Z}O_Z^{\oplus r}]\xrightarrow{q_Z}A_Z[0],\qquad \deg(P_Z)=[-1,0],$$
is a quasi-isomorphism of $O_Z$-complexes and $P_Z$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For every $K\in D(O_Z)$ there is a canonical isomorphism
$$P_Z\otimes_{O_Z}^LK\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_{a_Z}(A_Z\otimes_{O_Z}^LK),$$
induced by the augmentation; the left side is represented, for any representative $C^\bullet$ of $K$, by the direct-sum total tensor $P_Z\otimes_{O_Z}C^\bullet$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. All maps commute with inverse image along every scheme morphism, using the monoidal comparison [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp].
Let $f:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the canonical module adjunctions [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], and let $T_Z=A_Z\otimes_{O_Z}^L-$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change]. Define $\gamma_{f,K}:T_YRf_{*,O}K\to Rf_{*,A}T_XK$ as the $A$-adjunct of $T_X(\varepsilon_{f,K})\circ c_{f,Rf_{*,O}K}$, where $c_f:f_A^*T_Y\cong T_Xf_O^*$ is the canonical pullback/tensor comparison [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback](1). Under restriction of scalars and the above augmented-complex identifications, this actual $\gamma_{f,K}$ is the projection morphism
$$P_Y\otimes_{O_Y}^LRf_{*,O}K\longrightarrow Rf_{*,O}(P_X\otimes_{O_X}^LK)$$
defined by the canonical tensor comparison and the $O$-geometric counit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact, lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. This projection and $\gamma_{f,K}$ are isomorphisms for every unbounded $K$. No properness, quasi-compactness, constructibility or flatness of $A$ over $O$ is assumed. The case $A=0$ permits $r=0$.

proof.text: Obtain the arithmetic presentation, specified condensed arrows, rank-zero clause and quotient identification from perfectModelArithmetic_of_finite_integral, proved using the existing condensed-resolution theorem.
Apply derivedAssertions_of_finite_integral_resolution to that short exact sequence and its two finite free identifications. Retain its normalized beta, pullback square and actual mate equality.

Apply finiteFreeScalarProjection to the same specified cone. The mate equality makes beta_Y followed by restricted gamma, restrictionPush, and R(beta_X inverse) invertible. Cancel the surrounding isomorphisms. Exact restriction reflects isomorphisms: ordinary restriction is conservative after forgetting the action, and its derived functor commutes with cohomology. Hence gamma is invertible. Assemble all data in PerfectModel without changing any interface or hypothesis.
